code:
import math

PAGE = 16 * 1024      # InnoDB 页大小
KEY = 8               # bigint 主键
PTR = 6               # 页指针
ROW = 200             # 行平均大小(含主键/事务ID/回滚指针)

leaf_fanout = PAGE // (KEY + PTR)      # 非叶子节点每页指针数 = 扇出
leaf_capacity = PAGE // ROW            # 叶子节点每页行数

def tree_height(rows):
    """叶子页数 L，再按扇出逐层上收，总高度 = 非叶子层数 + 1。"""
    leaves = -(-rows // leaf_capacity)     # ceil 除法
    levels = 0
    cap = 1
    while cap < leaves:
        cap *= leaf_fanout
        levels += 1
    return levels + 1, leaves

print("=== InnoDB B+ 树扇出与树高 ===")
print("页大小            = %d B" % PAGE)
print("非叶子扇出(指针数) = %d" % leaf_fanout)
print("叶子每页行数       = %d" % leaf_capacity)
print()
print("%-14s %-10s %-10s %-12s" % ("行数", "叶子页数", "树高", "等值查询IO"))
rows_list = (1000, 100000, 10000000, 1000000000)
last = None
for rows in rows_list:
    h, leaves = tree_height(rows)
    print("%-14d %-10d %-10d %-12d" % (rows, leaves, h, h))
    last = h
print()
print("结论: 亿级数据树高也只有 %d 层, 等值查询最多 %d 次磁盘 IO" % (last, last))
print("      每次 IO 读一整页(含上千个键) -> 页利用率远高于二叉/红黑树")
